203 days from 1299-03-08.  
1299 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not 400 in Gregorian calendar).  
March: 31 days → 31-8 = 23 days used, leaves 180 days (203-23=180).  
April: 30 → 150 left. May: 31 → 119 left. June: 30 → 89 left. July: 31 → 58 left. August: 31 → 27 left. September: 30 → exceeds, so date in September: 27th.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1299-09-27
